findings.title: Lexical normalisation of STAGE0 pins misreads a '..' segment that follows a symlinked component (fail-safe NOT_EVALUATED; c2v001 read EVALUATED)
findings.evidence: _stage0_pin uses os.path.normpath on an absolute path. Probe DEV_dotdot_after_symlink: the record is named <d>/lnk/../stage0_status_record.json, with lnk pointing to <d>/real_parent/child. The kernel resolves that path to <d>/real_parent/stage0_status_record.json, which holds the sha-correct root bytes. c2v002 instead reads <d>/stage0_status_record.json, which is absent. Result: STAGE0_STATUS_RECORD_CUSTODY_MISMATCH and NOT_EVALUATED [STAGE0_RECEIPT_NOT_FINISHED, NO_SEALED_SUCCESSOR], while the freeze, verify and score all complete. The same record on c2v001 (realpath) reads EVALUATED. The change is fail-safe: the sha256 must still match, so it never yields a false EVALUATED and never causes a refusal. The README discloses lexical normalisation but not its '..' semantics, and no pinned producer writes such paths. Suggestion: treat a '..' segment as PIN_MALFORMED or ENTRY_MALFORMED, or state 'absolute, no ..' in the field map. Evidence: probe_out/p1b/PROBES_LENS.json, sha256 45adc5980549af729c55df7cef336e6834681d778abd2ba929f785223a40f746.
findings.label: TESTED

findings.title: Receipt coefficient_grid_sha256 is compared case-sensitively, unlike the pin and sealed-successor shas
findings.evidence: _stage0_apply_record tests rdoc['coefficient_grid_sha256'] != grid_sha with no lowercasing; pin shas and sealed_successor.module_sha256 are lowercased. Probe grid_sha_uppercase_in_receipt (the correct grid sha written in uppercase): STAGE0_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH and NOT_EVALUATED; the freeze and verify still succeed. This is fail-safe. The case of the real slots V003 grid sha is UNTESTED, because the file cannot be opened under 0708; root can confirm it from the bytes. Suggestion: lowercase both sides, or document lowercase in the receipt schema. Evidence: probe_out/p4/PROBES4_LENS.json, sha256 3d0157eedfd6d2c26076453ac71881860f458ae745f4dbd0509d4a1d377e9ea6.

findings.title: Mid-freeze race confirmed: a custody_ok STAGE0 file that changes or vanishes inside one write_freeze_manifest call refuses the whole freeze (README lists this as FORMAL)
findings.evidence: Probe B_race wraps _stage0_input_files. If the receipt is modified after the STAGE0 decision, the freeze is refused with 'REFUSED: assembled manifest fails the verifier structure check' and STAGE0_CUSTODY_FILE_NOT_PINNED. If it is removed, the freeze is refused with 'REFUSED: input_files[15]: unreadable'. No manifest is written in either case. This needs a root file to be edited or deleted during the call, which honest root does not do (exclusive create, no deletion). Every v003g input has the same exposure, and re-running the freeze recovers. Evidence: probe_out/p2/PROBES2_LENS.json, sha256 e6dfc10b450ddffbd25fc39d255434f8a055cb79b97ad9b44b278c1f3625b1ec.
